revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_011
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 11, ORANGE rank, FIRST medal in the orange pair. Based on the Chinese title concept "你的腿不是腿，是塞纳河畔的春水" (your legs are poetic river water). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 11 pose: the foot mascot dances gracefully and ridiculously beside stylized river waves, one tiny foot making a splash, holding a tiny flower or scarf with no markings, looking poetic but silly. Keep the foot as the main character.
Medal border: ORANGE rank, FIRST orange medal. Use warm orange and amber enamel circular ring with silver trim, small orange gems, small studs, and modest orange ornaments attached to the ring. IMPORTANT: no side wings, no feather wings, no large outward leaf wings, no big side fins. The silhouette must remain mostly circular with only small protrusions.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and previous anthropomorphic foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central foot mascot fully inside circular core. Base circle size consistent with previous tiers.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, poetic and funny.
Color palette: orange and amber border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, turquoise river accents, no gold dominance; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no wings, no feather wings, no external side wings, no large outward fins, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold; second medal of each color pair has wings
wing_rule: first medal in color pair has no wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
